answer: Because selection is random and the haven seed is unrevealed until close, an copycat cannot dodge the sample, so colluding to grade clones' junk is a lantern gamble with a negative expected value. The signal log keeps the sampled set and the penalty so the deterrent is verifiable. A random sample of settled verdicts is re-graded by an independent panel each epoch, and a divergence found on re-check costs the original grader 12% of its standing plus a seat ban. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
